item.description: Investing.com -- Bausch Health Companies Inc. (NYSE: BHC) reported third quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings per share of $1.77, beating the consensus estimate of $1.27 by $0.50. Revenue reached $2.94 billion, surpassing the $2.75 billion analyst estimate and marking a 10% increase from $2.68 billion in the same period last year.

item.description: VAUGHAN, Ontario, October 12, 2026--Bausch + Lomb Corporation (NYSE/TSX: BLCO), a leading global eye health company, and its parent company, Bausch Health Companies Inc. (NYSE/TSX: BHC), today announced that Bausch + Lomb Board of Directors Chairman Thomas J. Appio has been appointed interim chief executive officer, effective immediately. Appio will continue to serve as CEO of Bausch Health while assuming leadership of Bausch + Lomb.
